cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you the fireworks invoice, state exactly what you approved. I taught you to give a brief someone can follow, not just wave at the sky.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your wording first. Did 'make it memorable' include rockets? You used to skip the nouns when I asked for a brief.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Much more precise. When did you tell me the trailer limit? Put that date down before I show you the delivery date.
